topic: How does gateway separation distance affect spatial correlation and link budget margins in Q/V band feeder links?
consensus_response: The spatial correlation coefficient decreases exponentially with distance, impacting the diversity gain. A gateway separation distance of 50-70 km balances spatial correlation and link budget margins. Rain attenuation mitigation techniques, such as adaptive power control, adaptive beamforming, and site-specific optimization, can help manage the impact of rain attenuation. Spatial multiplexing and MIMO can increase the capacity of feeder links, and improved spatial correlation modeling will help make more accurate predictions of feeder link performance. These elements will contribute to creating a more advanced, efficient, and robust Q/V band feeder link network.
